plan.notes: Official AY2026-2027 suggested four-year plan (Rev. 07/26), Department of Chemistry, EIU. Transcribed at the plan's stated semester values: gen-ed flex rows at 6 SH, chemistry electives at 3 SH per term (within the printed 0-3 SH range). Plan sums to 116 SH as transcribed; the department's own footnote states the degree requires 120 SH minimum and 40 SH at the 3000+ level, with 9 additional SH at 3000+ needed as additional elective or gen-ed coursework — students fill the remaining hours with advisor guidance. Sophomore Fall: plan header states 15 SH but the listed courses sum to 14 SH (official 1-SH discrepancy). '*' marks courses offered only in the listed term.
